comments.body: One week of zero hits confirmed in access metrics; endpoints removed in release 3.14.

content.text: One week of zero hits confirmed in access metrics; endpoints removed in release 3.14.
Deprecated v1 list endpoints remain registered for compatibility even though public clients moved to v2 months ago.
Remove the handlers, update internal docs that still deep-link to the old paths, and return a clear gone response only if any residual traffic appears.
Confirm gateway access logs show zero production hits for a full week before the final delete ships.
